This valid product-negative result does not authorize a second canonical LIVE.

runs.classification_rationale: The Floor1 network and corrected Voice dependency order verified. All 21 phones reached FWD, held endpoint IPv4 addresses, and matched 21 authoritative DHCP bindings. A fresh complete five-page show ephone table exposed only 19 extensions and omitted 3001/3007 after the full 180-second observation. The immutable artifact lacked the raw table and resolved MAC/config batch, so product registration failure versus observer/pagination loss remained unresolved. Floor2 was not reached and its replay/PVST causal question received no evidence.

runs.classification_rationale: The retained raw IOS table proves ephone-7 was registered and the parser alone dropped it because its IP line was indented. The exact trusted phase-40 payload contains ephone 1 with a unique measured phone MAC, but all 33 raw registration samples omit ephone-1. APPLIED therefore diverged from raw readback before SCCP observation. The next experiment splits only independent BindPhoneToExtension mutations into one typed batch per action; it adds no retry, sleep, DHCP mutation, or policy change.

runs.classification_rationale: Twenty-one renderer batches with one typed phone binding each did not change the result: ephone-1 remained absent from all 35 raw samples while ephones 2-21 registered. The webview drains queued commands into one runCode batch, so renderer batch size alone does not establish mutation completion ordering. Batch size is refuted as sufficient. The next correction requires one exact ephone row readback to authorize the next binding and stops on absence without replay.

runs.classification_rationale: The state gate verified exact index, extension, and MAC for the first 11 binding mutations. The 12th mutation was dispatched, but its registered show-ephone read was pager-incomplete with confirmed source identity; the gate stopped later bindings before Voice signaling. This is an observer boundary, not evidence that the binding row was absent. The next implementation permits exactly one additional read-only query only after this qualified pager shape and never replays a binding.

runs.classification_rationale: After the qualified pager observer, the first 18 exact binding rows verified. Binding ephone 1 was then dispatched once with a unique measured MAC and was absent from a fresh complete five-page uniquely attributed table. The complete absence was not retried and later bindings remained unsent. Because opaque action-ID order placed directory index 1 nineteenth, the next single-variable experiment orders BindPhoneToExtension by semantic directory_index and tests ephone 1 first.

runs.classification_rationale: Changing only binding order made ephone 1 verify immediately and moved the complete-absence failure to ephone 19, still the nineteenth dispatched binding. Index-one behavior and opaque hash ordering are refuted as causes; the failure follows ordinal 19. The plan explicitly provisions every phone by measured MAC while CME auto-registration remains enabled for unknown phones. The next isolated correction disables unmanaged auto-registration and preserves explicit bindings plus mandatory SCCP verification.

runs.classification_rationale: Sizing Router4 to the physical 51-phone count caused every ephone binding row to remain absent; 51 is invalid on this Packet Tracer 2811 path. The next implementation models those capacities as generic Voice intent rather than inferring them from current phone count.

runs.classification_rationale: The retained five-page Router4 readback already contained the exact ephone-19 MAC and extension, but the pager continuation prefixed its header with one space. The strict header parser dropped that raw row while accepting rows 1-18,20,21, fabricating the ordinal-19 absence and triggering an unnecessary reconciliation. Replaying the archived raw window with leading header whitespace accepted yields all 21 rows, so product mutation loss is refuted and the observer cause is confirmed.

runs.classification_rationale: The normal production runner verified routing-core physical state, cumulative configuration, RIPv2 control plane, core forwarding, and two workspace observations. It then called input() at the routing-core checkpoint, but the non-interactive shell had already closed stdin, producing EOF before any continue or retain command. This is a checkpoint-command harness invocation failure; it contains no Floor1 parser or Floor2 product result. The next invocation supplies the bounded sequence of typed continue commands through persistent stdin.

runs.classification_rationale: The ephone header correction closed the full canonical Floor1 Voice lifecycle: all 21 phones had authoritative access forwarding, IPv4, matching DHCP bindings, and SCCP registration. Floor1 then failed closed because Router0 and Router3 show ip protocols reads were pager-truncated and therefore unobservable; Router4 process state and all nine required RIP route expectations verified. This is an observer stop, not a RIP product contradiction. The next correction performs at most one additional read-only process query only when the first result proves executed, fresh, incomplete, pager-truncated, continuation-failed, and uniquely attributed; no control-plane mutation is retried.
